models.club: An extracurricular club students can join, with meeting details, a staff patron, and a student president.
models.prefect: A student leader elected or appointed to the prefect body, shown with their role, class, and a personal quote.
models.schoolHouse: One of the school's four houses, identified by a name, colour, and motto, with a staff house master and student captain.
models.scoutsGroup: A uniformed extracurricular group (scouts, brigade, etc.) with meeting details and leadership.

relationships: Each club has one patron (staff) and one president (student)
Each schoolHouse has one houseMaster (staff) and one houseCaptain (student)
Each scoutsGroup has one patron (staff) and one leader (student)

clubs.name: Science & Technology Club
clubs.description: Explores real-world science through experiments, robotics projects, and visits to tech companies. Open to all students with a passion for STEM.

clubs.name: Drama & Creative Arts Society
clubs.description: Produces two major stage productions per year and trains students in acting, stagecraft, and public speaking. Welcomes all year groups.

clubs.name: Debate Club
clubs.description: Sharpens critical thinking and public speaking through inter-school debate competitions. Members compete at state and national levels.

clubs.name: Mathematics Club
clubs.description: Tackles challenging problems beyond the classroom syllabus and prepares students for mathematics olympiads at all levels.

clubs.name: Green Earth Environmental Club
clubs.description: Promotes sustainability on campus through recycling drives, tree planting, and environmental awareness campaigns.

clubs.name: French Language & Culture Club
clubs.description: Develops French language skills through conversation sessions, cultural events, and preparation for DELF certification.

prefects.name: Chukwuemeka Obi
prefects.quote: Leadership is not about being in charge — it is about taking care of those in your charge.

prefects.name: Amaka Nwosu
prefects.quote: We rise by lifting others. My goal is to leave this school better than I found it.

prefects.name: Tunde Adebayo
prefects.quote: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.

prefects.name: Aisha Ibrahim
prefects.quote: Sport teaches you character, challenges you, and teaches you what it means to never give up.

prefects.name: David Oyelaran
prefects.quote: A reader lives a thousand lives. I am here to open those doors for every student.

prefects.name: Chisom Adeleke
prefects.quote: A strong community is built one act of kindness at a time.

prefects.name: Kelechi Eze
prefects.quote: A clean environment is the first sign of a disciplined mind.

prefects.name: Ngozi Okafor
prefects.quote: Our culture is our identity — I am proud to celebrate and share it every day.

houses.name: Eagle House
houses.description: Eagle House embodies ambition and excellence, challenging its members to reach for the highest standards in academics and character.

houses.name: Lion House
houses.description: Lion House is built on bravery, resilience, and team spirit — qualities that define champions on the field and in the classroom.

houses.name: Dolphin House
houses.description: Dolphin House celebrates collaboration and creativity, fostering a community where every member supports and uplifts each other.

houses.name: Falcon House
houses.description: Falcon House values precision, integrity, and determination. Its members are known for their sharp focus and unwavering commitment.

scoutsGroups.name: Boy Scouts Troop
scoutsGroups.description: Develops boys into responsible, self-reliant young men through outdoor skills, community service, and character training aligned with the world scouting movement.

scoutsGroups.name: Girls Brigade Company
scoutsGroups.description: Builds young women of faith, discipline, and service through uniformed activities, skill development, and community outreach programmes.

scoutsGroups.name: Red Cross Society
scoutsGroups.description: Trains students in first aid, emergency response, and humanitarian values. Members serve at school events and participate in community health outreaches.
